shop/deployment/legacy
  SR002 [blocker] hostPath volume "scratch": its data is lost with the node
  SR004 [caveat] no topology spread or pod anti-affinity: replicas can land on the same node or zone
  SR005 [caveat] no PodDisruptionBudget: draining can remove too many replicas at once
  SR006 [caveat] container "legacy" has no readinessProbe: traffic can reach a pod that is not ready
  SR009 [info] no preStop hook: in-flight requests may be cut when the node is reclaimed
shop/statefulset/cache
  SR001 [blocker] runs with 1 replica: an interruption means downtime
  SR006 [caveat] container "cache" has no readinessProbe: traffic can reach a pod that is not ready
  SR007 [caveat] uses persistent volumes: zonal disks make rescheduling slower and tied to one zone
  SR009 [info] no preStop hook: in-flight requests may be cut when the node is reclaimed
shop/deployment/db
  SR001 [blocker] runs with 1 replica: an interruption means downtime
  SR006 [caveat] container "db" has no readinessProbe: traffic can reach a pod that is not ready
  SR007 [caveat] uses persistent volumes: zonal disks make rescheduling slower and tied to one zone
  SR009 [info] no preStop hook: in-flight requests may be cut when the node is reclaimed
shop/deployment/worker
  SR003 [caveat] terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 300s, but Spot gives only 120s of notice
  SR004 [caveat] no topology spread or pod anti-affinity: replicas can land on the same node or zone
  SR005 [caveat] no PodDisruptionBudget: draining can remove too many replicas at once
  SR006 [caveat] container "worker" has no readinessProbe: traffic can reach a pod that is not ready
  SR009 [info] no preStop hook: in-flight requests may be cut when the node is reclaimed
shop/job/import
  SR010 [blocker] backoffLimit is 0: a single lost pod fails the whole job
  SR012 [info] no podFailurePolicy that ignores DisruptionTarget: a pod lost to an interruption can count against backoffLimit
  SR013 [info] progress is lost on interruption unless the job checkpoints; the tool cannot verify that
